endorsements.quote: In practical terms, clinicians should add a brief intake question (“have you used an AI chatbot for advice about your medications or symptoms?”), treat any AI-sourced advice as a clinical input requiring independent evaluation, and document their reasoning when they accept or reject either a patient’s AI-sourced claim or a clinical decision support tool’s algorithmic suggestion.

unlisted_practices: Clinicians should add a brief intake question asking patients whether they have used an AI chatbot for advice about their medications or symptoms.
Clinicians should treat AI-sourced patient advice as a clinical input requiring independent evaluation.

screen.reason: This is a legal analysis and viewpoint commentary examining liability, malpractice, and governance considerations when AI chatbots provide prescribing advice directly to patients or via clinicians.
